questions.question: Who started Maison Roast, and when?
questions.expected_answer: Two friends, Elias and Maya, founded it in the autumn of 2018 by taking over a defunct cobbler's workshop in the arts district.

questions.question: Why is it called Maison Roast?
questions.expected_answer: "Maison" is French for house or home, evoking European baking and hospitality; "Roast" is the physical act of transforming green coffee beans over heat. Together they say roasting and baking are domestic crafts, best shared in a home among friends.

questions.question: Is Maison Roast a fancy, formal kind of café?

expected_chunks.title: Maison Roast — Vintage Style Social Description
expected_chunks.heading: A Youthful Vintage, Not a Museum Piece

expected_chunks.title: Maison Roast — Vintage Style Social Description
expected_chunks.heading: What Vintage Style Is Not

questions.expected_answer: No. The vintage look is paired with youthful, free-spirited energy; it is not a stuffy, formal or exclusive café. There are no velvet ropes or dress code, and everyone is welcome.

questions.question: How long do I have to ask for a refund on an online order?
questions.expected_answer: Within 14 days of delivery. The product must be unopened in its original sealed packaging, unless it arrived damaged or defective, in which case packaging status doesn't matter.

questions.question: My order showed up crushed and one item is missing. What should I do?
questions.expected_answer: Report it within 24 hours of delivery with photos. Maison Roast will either replace the damaged or missing items at no cost or give a full refund for them, whichever the customer prefers.

questions.question: Once my refund is approved, how long until I see the money?
questions.expected_answer: Refunds are processed within 7 business days of receiving and inspecting the returned item, back to the original payment method. The bank may take another 3–5 business days to show it. A confirmation email is sent when it is issued.

questions.question: What email do I write to if I want to dispute a refund decision?
questions.expected_answer: maison.roast.customer.services@gmail.com — or the contact form on the website. They reply within 2 business days.

questions.question: I live 6 km from the shop. How much will delivery cost?
What happens if my delivery takes longer than 3 hours?
questions.expected_answer: The delivery fee is waived entirely if it takes more than 3 hours from when the order was accepted. Delays caused by weather are not Maison Roast's responsibility.
questions.notes: Two chunks: the waiver is in the H1 preamble (empty heading); the weather exception is in Delivery Delays.

questions.question: Can I cancel my order after placing it?

expected_chunks.title: Refund Policy — Maison Roast
expected_chunks.heading: Change of Mind or Wrong Order

questions.expected_answer: For delivery orders, yes, within 30 minutes of placing it; after that it may already be in preparation. (The refund policy also mentions contacting them within 48 hours, before it ships, for shipped online purchases.)
questions.notes: Conflicting sources: 30 minutes (delivery) vs 48 hours before shipping (refund policy). A good answer gives 30 minutes for delivery orders and does not merge the two.

questions.question: Does the carrot cake have nuts in it?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, it contains walnuts. It also contains gluten/wheat, dairy and egg, with a cream cheese frosting.

questions.question: Which of your desserts are gluten-free?

expected_chunks.title: Maison Roast — Allergen Reference
expected_chunks.heading: Note on Gluten-Free and Dairy-Free Options

questions.expected_answer: None can be guaranteed gluten-free, since wheat flour is used throughout the shared kitchen. Desserts without intentional gluten are chocolate mousse, crème brûlée, panna cotta, frozen yogurt and ice cream.
questions.notes: Safety: must not call anything gluten-free without the cross-contact caveat.

questions.question: I have a severe peanut allergy. Is the tiramisu safe for me?

expected_chunks.title: Maison Roast — Allergen Reference

questions.expected_answer: Peanuts are not a listed ingredient in the tiramisu, but peanuts are used in the same kitchen on shared equipment, so cross-contact can't be ruled out. With a severe allergy, speak to a staff member in person before ordering rather than relying on the chatbot.
questions.notes: Safety-critical. Fails if Basil says it is safe.

questions.expected_answer: Colombia is the backbone of the roasting program: high-altitude, washed Arabica. Colombian lots often appear in the rotation, and staff are happy to say which origin is in the grinder today.

questions.question: What water temperature should I use to brew coffee at home?

expected_chunks.title: Maison Roast — Allergen Reference
expected_chunks.heading: 7 Things That Make a Good Coffee Delicious

questions.expected_answer: Between 195°F and 205°F (90°C–96°C). Boiling water scorches the coffee and pulls out bitter compounds.

questions.question: What's the difference between a light roast and a dark roast?
questions.expected_answer: Light roast comes out just after the first crack: it keeps the origin character, bright acidity, floral or fruity notes, and has no surface oil. Dark roast goes into the second crack: oils come to the surface and it tastes bold, heavy and smoky or bittersweet, more of the roast than the origin.

questions.question: What does rennet actually do when you make cheese?
questions.expected_answer: Rennet is an enzyme added to the acidified milk that makes the casein proteins link together into a soft gel, the curd. It traditionally came from calf stomachs; microbial and vegetable rennets are common today. Some cheeses rely mainly on acid instead.
questions.notes: The process section is long and split into overlapping pieces; checks the Coagulation step is retrieved.

questions.question: Can you name a few blue cheeses?
questions.expected_answer: Roquefort, Gorgonzola and Stilton, which are inoculated with mold cultures.

questions.question: What temperature is the oil when you fry beignets?
questions.expected_answer: 360°F (180°C). They're fried until golden on both sides, drained, then dusted generously with powdered sugar while warm.
questions.notes: Near-miss risk: the cannoli recipe fries at 175–180°C; must not answer with the cannoli range.
